variants.title: 01 / 软陶积木港湾
variants.art: STYLE: tactile miniature 3D CLAY TOY harbor, soft ceramic/plastic surfaces, rounded chunky boxes and boats with gentle bevels, tiny sculpted cranes and seagulls only as atmospheric background. Cream, apricot, coral red, pale turquoise, butter yellow, deep petrol text. Warm daylight, lovely ambient occlusion and soft shadows, welcoming cozy playful casual puzzle game. Handcrafted stop-motion softness but very readable UI. Home features a charming large miniature harbor island in turquoise water with toy cargo ship. Gameplay environment a frontal dollhouse dock, crates arranged in exact front-facing stacks. Puffy pill buttons and inset rounded temporary bays. Level selection is a winding harbor walkway with chunky numbered buoy markers. Component dialogs look like small rounded cream ceramic plaques. Board backdrop warm ivory with subtle clay-color blocks; title friendly weighty rounded sans Chinese. This direction must be lush physically sculpted, not flat vectors, not generic gradients.
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: HIGH FIDELITY GAME UI ART DIRECTION BOARD for a real Chinese portrait mobile puzzle game 港口装箱 (Port Cargo).
Create one polished landscape 3:2 board, as high resolution as possible, ideally 3072 x 2048. Treat this as an art director's finished visual proposal, with beautiful game artwork and precise UI. Not wireframes, not a web dashboard. No device hardware mockups. Large crisp readable simplified Chinese text.
Composition: a quiet editorial top heading about 10% of the board; below it THREE large portrait mobile game screens side by side, each aspect ratio about 390:844, occupying about 73% width. A fourth narrower component-specimen column on the right occupies remaining 23%. Screens aligned, ample margins, each game screen completely contained and uncropped. Small captions above screens: 全局入口 / 局内画面 / 关卡选择. Fourth column title: UI 组件.
GLOBAL SCREEN: brand 港口装箱, strong evocative harbor scene or style-specific emblem, primary button 继续装箱 with 第06关, secondary 选择关卡 and 设置. The global entry is proposed. No currency, hearts, score, stars, rewards, timer, shop, battlepass or fake stats.
GAMEPLAY SCREEN exact mechanically meaningful common benchmark:
Top small title 第06关 and settings icon button. Upper berth: current ship requesting red vertically-striped cargo, a small specimen R stripe icon and text 条纹, numeric loading progress 0 / 3. Compact next ship preview: blue dotted B icon ×3 then green diagonal G icon ×3; small button 船队.
Central yard has EXACTLY THREE separated VERTICAL stacks of THREE square front-facing crates each. All stacks aligned at bottom. Crates occupy comfortably large area. Stack ONE bottom to top is red vertical stripe, red vertical stripe, blue dots. Stack TWO bottom to top is blue dots, red vertical stripe, green diagonal stripes. Stack THREE bottom to top is green diagonal stripes, green diagonal stripes, blue dots. Top crates vivid with selectability rims, covered crates readable but subdued. Do not draw an arbitrary candy match grid. Cargo: red with vertical bars; blue with dots; green with diagonal strokes. Color AND pattern redundant. Center helper 点取堆顶货箱. Beneath yard exactly THREE empty temporary slots clearly labeled 暂存 0 / 3. Bottom two large controls 撤销 (disabled at initial board) and 提示 with 免费1次. No fourth buffer slot. All gameplay targets usable and unobscured. The berth is visual harbor ship not tiny abstract label.
LEVEL SELECT SCREEN: title 选择关卡. Show ten positions numbered 01 to 10. Levels 01-05 show small checkmark completed, 06 highlighted current, 07-10 visibly locked. NO rating stars. Return control.
COMPONENT COLUMN: 1) three cargo samples in red stripe, blue dots, green slashes; 2) compact success dialog 装船完成 with 下一关 and 重玩本关; 3) compact blocked dialog 暂存已满 with 撤销 and 重新开始; 4) settings specimen 暂停 / 音效 / 音乐 / 减少动效 with toggle controls; 5) button normal/pressed/disabled specimens, four or five small palette swatches.
Keep texts short, clean and legible. No decorative fake gibberish. UI components coherent within this one art direction. The three complete game screens should dominate, with genuine environmental art and clear hierarchy. Screen layouts must feel playable. Entire design board polished, no watermarks.

variants.title: 02 / 深海调度终端
variants.art: STYLE: premium industrial maritime CONTROL CONSOLE in deep midnight navy with phosphor cyan fine linework, amber signals, worn gunmetal chamfered panels, precise technical typography and engraved labels. Think credible future port dispatch equipment, restrained functional science fiction, sophisticated physical buttons. NOT neon purple gaming UI. Ambient dark teal port at night rendered with technical wireframe overlays and detailed gantry-crane silhouettes. Home features harbor radar schematic plus ship silhouette and a large amber rectangular ENGAGE-style Chinese action button. Gameplay split into a detailed upper berth monitor, dominant clearly vertical container-yard stacks with ribbed metal crates bearing stripe/dot/slash classification, bottom framed three-cell buffer. A slim technical vertical rail may label zones; never crowd core UI. Level select has ten dispatch-file rows in two rigid columns with small status lamps. Dialogs are beveled dark metal alert panels with amber caution corner details, cyan toggles. Board backdrop blue-black, typographic grid, thin measurement lines and micro zone identifiers. Strong deliberate angular geometry, no rounded bubble cards, no toy material. Cargo colors visible but muted industrial R red, B blue, G green.

variants.title: 03 / 复古航运票据
variants.art: STYLE: distinctive vintage maritime LETTERPRESS PRINT AND PAPER EPHEMERA, warm yellowed ivory ticket stock, dark indigo ink, vermilion red stamps, sea-glass green, faded cornflower blue. Beautiful restrained woodcut/linocut harbor illustration, paper fibers and slight registration grain, no photorealism. Chinese title bold printed with an elegant serif/song-style character, small labels typewriter-inspired yet readable. Home a vintage shipping poster featuring bold illustrated steam tug, crane and striped cargo, perforated boarding-ticket primary action. Gameplay upper ship is woodcut side view, containers rectangular ink stamped square wooden/corrugated boxes with R bars B dots G slash markings. The three tall stacks sit on a printed dock baseline, and temporary slots are outlined manifest stamp boxes. Bottom actions tear-off tickets, no pills. Level select a large open cargo manifest with ten numbered ticket stubs, completed stubs stamped with check mark, current 06 red-framed, future perforated stubs locked. Dialogs are stacked printed dispatch slips, success vermilion stamp impression and actual labeled controls. Board resembles carefully composed printed brand sheet on warm paper, thin rules, tactile but spacious. Must feel analog collectible stationery and folk maritime art, visually nothing like corporate tech or soft 3D.

variants.title: 04 / 潮汐留白
variants.art: STYLE: radical ultra-clean FLAT TWO-DIMENSIONAL SWISS MODERNIST graphic puzzle design. Off-white/very pale cool gray, near-black typography, bold cobalt blue, restrained coral and mint for cargo only. Pure geometric vector-like shapes, NO shadows, NO textures, NO gradients, NO rounded-card dashboard. Strong asymmetric typographic compositions, editorial negative space, crisp 1px dividers and oversized numerals. Harbor becomes a poetic abstract geometric boat and crane illustration: blocks, semicircles, long straight lines. Home large bold title in asymmetric top-left grid, oversized abstract ship in central negative space, wide rectangular cobalt 继续装箱 button near bottom. Gameplay upper area boldly shows 06 at left then clean ship silhouette and numeric 0/3. Three exact crate stacks are spare flat colored squares marked with strong white bars/dots/slashes and clear spacing, no isometric depth. Buffer three unfilled black square outlines. Bottom 撤销 thin outline button and 提示 solid cobalt button. Level select huge numbers 01-10 arranged as a clean typographic index/grid with fine rules; current 06 cobalt background, ticks and locks distinct. Dialogs white sheets with strong black titles, thin rules, one strong cobalt action. Board itself warm white, huge editorial 04 title, perfect alignment. Feel calm, intelligent, art-museum print quality and immediate comprehension; simplicity must still be visually authored and polished.
